newsitem.title: EGYPT: Suspected Moslem militants kill lawyer in Egypt.
newsitem.headline: Suspected Moslem militants kill lawyer in Egypt.

text.p: Suspected Moslem militants in southern Egypt on Thursday shot dead a lawyer they thought was a police informer, security sources said on Friday.
The gunmen, believed to be members of the Gama'a al-Islamiya (Islamic Group), shot Asham Nabih Tawfik, director of legal affairs in the town council, cut off his head and hid it, the sources said.
The gunmen escaped into the fields around Om Algsour village, near the southern town of Mallawi, which has been a hotbed of militant violence.

Gama'a members, seeking to overthrow the government and replace it by a strict Islamist state, have targeted security personnel, their civilian aides, tourists, Christians and informers in their four-year-old armed struggle.
About 1,000 people, mainly militants and policemen, have been killed in political violence in Egypt since 1992.
